rationale: Calculated steady-state heat balance per metre of conductor at T_max=75°C. R_hot=0.00014415 Ohm/m. For each timestamp: convection uses wind^0.6, radiation uses Stefan-Boltzmann law with pi*D surface area, solar gain uses projected width D. Ampacity = sqrt((convection + radiation - solar) / R_hot). Minimum ampacity occurs at t01 (high ambient 31°C, low wind 0.7 m/s, high solar 850 W/m2). Scheduled current 520A exceeds rating only at t01.
